messages:
alex: FYI — noticed a weird regression on the qx2b quant bring-up. Canary generation quality dropped ~6% after the ingest tokenizer tweak. :eyes:

maria: can you paste the failing sample ids? are these newly ingested or from older buckets?

alex: spike originates from samplebank shard 42. examples where tokenizer started splitting ascii/emoji differently, which changed fingerprints and created near-duplicates. sample ids: 98321, 98322, 98380.

sanjay: @alex can you run a tokenizer diff and also compare token counts for qx2b vs qx2b-int4? quick one-liner I use below.

```
# quick tokenizer diff (internal)
python tools/token_diff.py --ids 98321,98322,98380 --encoders utf8 v2
```

alex: pasted minimal diff output: 
```
98321: orig_tokens=["hello", ",", "world"] new_tokens=["he", "llo", ",", "world"]
98322: orig_tokens=["🙂"] new_tokens=["\uFFFD", "\u263A"]  # emoji split/replacement
98380: orig_tokens=["http://ex"] new_tokens=["http", "://", "ex"]
```

katie: labeler-bot queue shows duplicate labeling tasks for these ids; label volatility up ~12% last 2h. annotators seeing two slightly different prompts that used to be deduped.

labeler-bot: automated: duplicates generated: [98321, 98322, 98400]; dedupe-similarity-threshold was 0.92, token-change reduced similarity to ~0.86 for those pairs.

maria: is this purely a curation/sampling problem or could it explain the model quality regression on canary?

sanjay: both. Tokenization drift changes input tokenization -> different KV cache keys and micro-batching alignment in the runtime. For quantized kernels (int4 path) we've seen different decoding paths and slight score shifts. If inputs get split differently, embeddings change, rerank changes, etc.

alex: agree. plan: rollback the ingest tokenizer change, regenerate fingerprints for the affected shard, rerun dedupe, and requeue deduped label tasks. I'll also capture the model diffs for a small canary set.

katie: I'll pause label assignment for shard 42 and notify ops to hold the tokenizer deploy.

maria: let's add a short checklist item to the model-onboarding runbook: "tokenizer-stability-check" that compares old/new encodings for a sample slice and verifies fingerprint stability (delta < 0.02) before ingest changes.

sanjay: also recommend a tiny unit test in the quant-bench that verifies same-tokenization -> identical beam path for deterministic seeds across quant/float builds.

alex: creating ticket RN with repro logs and token diffs, will link to the canary eval. posting results to the bringup channel when done. thanks all :thumbsup:
